labs.research_summary: A multidisciplinary hub at MIT Sloan for research on work and employment that aims to improve jobs for workers and to guide managers and policymakers, and runs a PhD program and a weekly seminar.

labs.join_notes: This is the school-wide MIT Sloan careers page, linked from the IWER site footer; it points to MIT's central staff job listings and to Sloan faculty openings and says nothing specific to IWER. The IWER start page also links a page about its PhD program, which was not read.
labs.notes: IWER's People page names two co-directors: Emilio J. Castilla (recorded) and Erin Kelly. Count is from that page and includes the co-directors, the 8 people listed under IWER Faculty, postdocs, predoctoral researchers and the one staff member. Left out: 20 affiliated faculty and researchers (mostly with homes in other Sloan groups or other MIT departments), 2 research affiliates/senior fellows (residency not stated), 6 PhD students listed as a group, and alumni. admin_name is Dahye Kim, the only person under IWER Staff (Associate Director); no email is shown for her or for IWER.
